en.entrarLead: Type your email and I'll send a link. No password to create, remember or leak.
en.opcionalTexto: The tool records, transcribes and produces the document without it —
en.opcionalFim: . The account is for tracking tickets, invoices, licence and team. Neither with it nor without it does your video leave your machine.
en.olheLead: I sent a link to {email}. It opens your account and is good for one hour.
en.olheAjuda: Nothing arrived? Check the spam folder, or {link}. The link is single-use — if your email client previews links, it may have been spent before you clicked.
en.erroEmail: That address does not look like an email.
en.erroEnvio: I couldn't send the link right now. Try again in a minute.
en.erroVendaDesligada: The checkout isn't live yet. Write to me and I'll sort it out by hand.

en.erroSemAssinatura: I couldn't find a subscription for that email.
en.erroLinkSemCodigo: The link came without its code. Ask for another.
en.erroLinkUsado: That link was already used or has expired. Ask for another — it takes a minute.
en.erroSemChave: You are signed in, but the server isn't configured to read your data. That's my configuration, not your problem.
en.erroLeitura: I couldn't read your data right now. Try reloading in a minute.

en.degustacao: During the trial you get everything. When it ends, the tool keeps working on the Free plan — nothing locks, nothing disappears, and what you already produced is yours.
en.vendaDesligada: Billing isn't switched on yet. Meanwhile the trial stands, and anyone who wants to subscribe early can talk to me directly.
en.faturasRodape: The Brazilian tax receipt is issued after payment and shows up here when it does. The card receipt is in the subscription portal.
en.chamadosVazio: No tickets. To open one, use “report a problem” at the foot of the tool — the diagnostics travel with it and you see exactly what is being sent before it goes.
en.tempoResposta: I've been replying in {horas}h on average across the last {quantos} replies. That's the real number, not a promised deadline.
en.tempoRespostaRapido: I've been replying in under an hour on average across the last {quantos} replies. That's the real number, not a promised deadline.
en.timeAviso: Blocking stops the NEXT issue — a licence already in someone's browser is good until it expires. That's why the term matters: at 7 days a cut takes effect in a week; at 90, it can take three months.
en.timeConfigTexto: This is pushed to the tool of anyone who signs in with this account: the document is born with the right name and logo.
en.erroNaoAdmin: Only an account admin can do that.
en.erroEmailInvalido: That address does not look like an email.
en.erroJaDeOutro: That email already belongs to another account.
en.erroSemAssento: No free seat. Raise the seat count or free one up.
en.rotEntreLead: Sign in to see and organise your test runs.
en.rotVendaLead: Test runs are part of the paid plans. They exist for people who execute many cases in a row:
en.rotVenda1: the spreadsheet goes in once and becomes a queue of cases;
en.rotVenda2: each case becomes a link that opens the tool already filled in;
en.rotVenda3: the spreadsheet comes back with what was done, by whom and when.
en.rotVazio: No test runs yet. Start by sending a spreadsheet below.
en.rotGrupoMeusSub: Only you can see these. This is the run of whoever executes.
en.rotGrupoTimeSub: Everyone with a seat can see these. This is the run of whoever coordinates.
en.rotImportarTexto: Excel, CSV or pasted from Excel. Only the case columns are read — no file is stored.
en.rotColarPlaceholder: Paste the rows you copied from Excel
en.rotConferirTitulo: Check what was understood before saving
en.rotRepetidos: There are repeated case codes. The code is the key of the run — two cases with the same code become one.
en.rotVoltandoTitulo: You came back from a case
en.rotVoltandoSemArq: Confirm to mark this case as done.
en.rotPrivacidade: What is stored here is the list: case, title, system, ticket, owner, date and the document fingerprint. The video, the frames, the transcript and the document never leave your browser.
en.rotSoPago: Test runs are part of the paid plans.
en.rotErroSemAcesso: This run is not yours nor your team’s.
en.rotErroNaoAdmin: Only the team admin hands out cases.
en.rotErroSoDono: Only whoever created the run can delete it.
en.rotErroForaDoTime: That person has no seat on your team.
en.rotErroSemCasos: I found no cases in that spreadsheet.
en.rotErroVazio: Send a file or paste the rows.
en.rotErroLer: I could not read that spreadsheet.
en.rotErroGrande: File too large (the limit is 4 MB).
en.rotErroMuitas: Spreadsheet too long (the limit is 2000 cases).
en.rotAnexoAviso: The complete .json has the frame IMAGES inside it. Attaching it is the one thing in this product that stores content of yours on a server of ours — and you can delete it at any time. With no attachment, only the receipt is kept: numbers, no images.
en.rotErroAnexoGrande: The attachment is over 32 MB. The case was marked done; the file was not uploaded.
en.rotErroAnexoTipo: The attachment must be the session .json. The case was marked done; the file was not uploaded.
en.rotErroAnexoSubir: The case was marked done, but I could not store the attachment.
en.rotErroAnexoApagar: I could not delete the file. Nothing was changed — try again.
en.timeModelosOnde: Templates are born inside the tool, under “Save as my template” — that is where the scenario, the label, the system and the role are already filled in. Here you see and delete them.
en.licTexto: It is the line that connects the plan to the tool. It is checked inside your browser and works offline — there is no licence server to call, and we never learn when you use it.
en.licAbrir: Open the tool with the plan on
en.licErro: I could not issue the key right now.
en.licTesteUsado: This e-mail has already used the 14-day trial. To carry on, pick a paid plan above.
en.licSemSegredo: The issuer is down. Write to the contact in the footer.
en.timeNada: Nothing you record passes through here. This area holds seats, invoices, document defaults and the case list — video, audio and transcripts still never leave your computer, on the paid plan the same as on the free one.
en.timeFormatoTexto: How the document COMES OUT, not just what it looks like. Half the evidence in A4 and half in Letter is the difference nobody sees across forty files and somebody asks about in the meeting. Everything here is a default: it arrives filled in and can still be changed on the case where it does not fit.
en.timeHash: Print the SHA-256 fingerprint of every image
